drafts.text:
A guy in my replies said something simple. You don't have to label the outcome of a trade. It's not genius or stupid, it just happened.
I read it and knew exactly why it hit.
I turn every loss into "I'm an idiot" and every win into "keep going."
That's how I stay stuck. Not the market. Me, grading myself after every candle.
drafts.source: Jesus's own real reply to @EdmundoFutures (147 likes), quoted almost verbatim, not an invented version
drafts.why: This is Jesus's own real quote, sharper than the agent's cycle #5 invented version of the same idea. Real words from a 147-like reply beat anything drafted from scratch.
drafts.why_es: Es la cita real del propio Jesus, más afilada que la versión inventada del agente en el ciclo #5 sobre la misma idea. Palabras reales de una respuesta con 147 likes le ganan a cualquier cosa redactada desde cero.

drafts.text:
A few of you told me this week I needed some time off.
I didn't argue back. I just took it.
Spent the weekend with my kids instead of a chart.
The account that's still open didn't need me hovering over it either.
Maybe listening is a skill too, not just reacting fast.
drafts.source: @LPH733's "you need some time off" (240 likes) + Jesus's own reply "a pause might be the only smart move left" (163 likes), real cause-and-effect that led to the 5 sep rest post
drafts.why: Names a real, honest through-line (audience told him to stop, he did) instead of presenting the rest post as unexplained filler. Victory format because listening and following through is itself a small win.
drafts.why_es: Nombra un hilo real y honesto (la audiencia le dijo que parara, y lo hizo) en vez de presentar el post de descanso como relleno sin explicación. Formato victoria porque escuchar y seguirlo es en sí mismo una pequeña victoria.

drafts.text:
Somebody in my replies said put a picture of your kids on your desk so you remember why you're doing this before you click.
I haven't done it yet. I don't have a good reason why not.
Anyone else have the thing that would actually stop them, and just... not do it?
drafts.source: @LPH733's comment ("put a picture of your kids on your desk... make it count", 35 likes) on the 15K post, still open in the backlog
drafts.why: On-brand family angle for @TradeDadLog's dad identity, honest about not yet acting on good advice. Complaint+question is the confirmed strongest recent-week format for reply volume.
drafts.why_es: Ángulo familiar muy propio de la identidad de papá de @TradeDadLog, honesto sobre no haber seguido todavía un buen consejo. Queja+pregunta es el formato más fuerte confirmado de la semana reciente para volumen de respuestas.
